description: Land Acquisition - Aluthgama Bogamuwa, Gampaha D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically declares that a particular land parcel is needed for public purpose and will be acquired, providing detailed land description including location, boundaries, and extent. This falls squarely under "Land and property-related matters" as defined in Type 4, involving land acquisition which is a core land administration function.
